show.description: A dying industrialist binds a mysterious stranger to his family with a vow—unaware that the man he forces into his granddaughter’s life is no ordinary servant, but a hidden king. For three years, Jay lives as a nobody, silently protecting Riya and her crumbling empire, enduring humiliation, neglect, and heartbreak. Blinded by ambition and class pride, Riya mistakes loyalty for weakness and throws him out of her life.
